target_customer: Companies with knowledge workers that want to measure and fix repetitive work, including with AI agents
problem: Companies do not know where employee and agent time goes, so repetitive tasks and bottlenecks go unmeasured.
business_model: B2B software with a desktop app (pricing not public)
product_category: Task mining and operational intelligence for AI agents

founders.name: Aidan Pratt
prior_employers: Seed to Series A startups (unnamed on YC page)
education: Georgia Tech, Machine Learning and Computer Science (YC page)

competitors.name: Celonis
competitors.what: Process mining and task mining platform

competitors.name: Skan AI
competitors.what: Task mining and process intelligence for regulated enterprises
competitors.traction_then: Named in Gartner 2026 task mining market guide per roundup

technical_complexity.rationale: Desktop capture across companies without integrations and ranking of tasks by cost is standard engineering with some hard ML parts.

defensibility.rationale: Compounding company context could create lock in, but task mining is an established category.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents already shipped task mining; outcome for Autostep unknown.

market_need_then: Enterprises were buying process intelligence and trying to price AI agent ROI; the company cites a 10 person team finding $100K plus of waste (company claim).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident, lightly playful, signs off with an avocado emoji

brand_strength.rationale: No public brand coverage was found.

outcome_analysis: Autostep is a one person Spring 2026 company, so no outcome exists yet. It enters task mining where Celonis and Skan are established, and its angle is pricing both human and agent work and then building the fix. Reported revenue growth is unverified and survival depends on raising a seed round and hiring.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators report about $500K in June 2026 (VCBacked pre-seed with YC only, Caplight seed with Neo and YC). Neo backing is on the company site. YC page says the company is raising. Primary partner David Lieb. Outcome search found nothing about Autostep. Completeness pass: the $500K pre-seed (June 2026) rests on databases only (FundedIQ, VCBacked); Caplight labels it seed dated 2026-06-01 and the founder says the company was raising a seed at Demo Day, so stage is uncertain.
